result.title: TangentPDE: Learning Local Operator Responses with Sparse Finite-Difference Supervision
result.summary: Neural PDE operators are often optimized through state reconstruction, which largely constrains operator values at observed inputs but does not fully characterize their sensitivity to local perturbations. A more faithful approximation of operator behavior requires not only accurate state predictions, but also correct variations along local perturbation directions. We present TangentPDE, which uses finite differences to approximate directional derivatives and constructs task-relevant finite-step responses from the state outputs of a reference solver at sparse paired inputs. Its objective jointly constrains state fidelity, response-direction alignment, and response-magnitude calibration, thereby learning both operator values and their local variations. Because the response labels are constructed solely from state outputs at paired inputs, the method requires neither explicit derivative labels, linearized or adjoint PDE solves, nor full Jacobians, and remains applicable to nonlinear solvers without derivative interfaces. Building on this, we additionally propose a selectively executed adaptation mechanism to strengthen local operator representations under finite-difference supervision. Budget-matched and correspondence-perturbed controls isolate the effect of relational supervision from improvements attributable to additional state observations or increased data volume. Designed as a plug-and-play training framework, TangentPDE integrates with diverse neural-operator backbones. Across four PDE systems and 20 task-backbone settings, TangentPDE lowers the three-seed mean state error in 18 settings and the corresponding Rollout@20 error in 18, while intrinsic finite-step response gains are strongest on DiffReact and remain task- and backbone-dependent elsewhere.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 TangentPDE，用参考求解器在稀疏配对输入上的状态输出做有限差分，构造有限步方向响应标签，联合约束状态保真、响应方向对齐与响应幅度校准，并可插拔地接入多种神经 PDE 算子骨干。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「由配对输入构造局部响应监督、无需显式导数或 Jacobian」的做法，可供核查 LVR 中潜在状态更新方向与轨迹贡献分配的训练监督设计；但对象是 PDE 算子，与视觉语言推理无直接关联。
